Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_WeatherEnabled_t: Apply weather overrides only if they make the night darker.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_WeatherSnow_tool: Set nighttime darkness during snowfall. Blizzards use their own setting.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_WeatherCloudsFog: Set nighttime darkness when cloud cover is at least 50% or fog is active. Rain and snow use their own settings.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_WeatherLightRain: Set nighttime darkness during drizzle, showers, and moderate rain.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_WeatherHeavyRain: Set nighttime darkness during heavy rain, thunderstorms, and tropical storms.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_InterfaceEnabled: Show the moon phase beside the clock.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_RevealHours: Hours before sunset to reveal tonight's phase
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_RevealHours_tool: Show tonight's phase this many whole hours before sunset. The display stays hidden until then. Use -1 to always show tonight's phase.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_NewMoon_tooltip: Set nighttime darkness during the new moon.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_WaxingCrescent_t: Set nighttime darkness during the waxing crescent.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_FirstQuarter_too: Set nighttime darkness during the first quarter.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_WaxingGibbous_to: Set nighttime darkness during the waxing gibbous.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_FullMoon_tooltip: Set nighttime darkness during the full moon.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_WaningGibbous_to: Set nighttime darkness during the waning gibbous.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_ThirdQuarter_too: Set nighttime darkness during the third quarter.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_WaningCrescent_t: Set nighttime darkness during the waning crescent.
Sandbox_MoonlightPhases_Debug_tooltip: Log moon phases, weather categories, and nighttime darkness changes.
